```{r}
# --- Setup
# Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

# Settings
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 14))
theme_update(
  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
)

# Define input files (written by scripts/05a_prep-qc-tables.R)
indir <- here("results/stats/summaries")
all_file <- file.path(indir, "sample-by-locus-stats.tsv")
sample_file <- file.path(indir, "per-sample-stats.tsv")

# Read input files
# `z_class` is NA for every autosomal locus, so its type has to be given or readr
# guesses logical from the leading rows and drops the real classes
all <- read_tsv(all_file, col_types = cols(z_class = "c", .default = col_guess()))
# Carries the sample metadata as well as the depth and sex calls
per_sample <- read_tsv(sample_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Compute means by sample, over the loci in the final data set only
all_smp <- all |>
  filter(retained_final) |>
  summarize(geno_pct = mean(geno_pct, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c("sample", "genotype")) |>
  left_join(per_sample, by = "sample") |>
  mutate(contam = factor(contam, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE), labels = c("no", "yes")))
```

```{r}
# Check metadata
#per_sample |> count(land_type)
```

```{r}
varplot <- function(
    df,
    genotype,
    x = "contam",
    fill = "species",
    facet = "species",
    title = NULL,
    xlab = "Likely contaminated?"
    ) {
  
  fgeno <- genotype
  ftitle <- if (is.null(title)) genotype else title
  
  df |>
    filter(genotype == fgeno) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[x]], fill = .data[[fill]], y = geno_pct)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      fill = "grey40",
      shape = 21,
      alpha = 0.5,
      size = 2.75
    ) +
    facet_wrap(vars(.data[[facet]])) +
    labs(
      title = ftitle,
      x = xlab,
      y = "Number of sites per 100 bp"
    ) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "italic"))
}
```

## Genotype count plots

### By species

```{r}
# Homozygous non-ref sites
alt_title <- "Nr. of homozygous non-reference sites"
varplot(df = all_smp, genotype = "n_alt", title = alt_title)

# Heterozygous sites
het_title <- "Nr. of heterozygous sites"
varplot(df = all_smp, genotype = "n_het", title = het_title)

# Total nr. of differences from the reference
diff_title <- "Total nr. of differences from the reference"
varplot(df = all_smp, genotype = "n_diff", title = diff_title)
```

### *jararaca* mainland vs island

```{r}
all_smp |>
  filter(species == "jararaca") |>
  varplot(genotype = "n_alt", fill = "land_type", facet = "land_type", title = alt_title)

all_smp |>
  filter(species == "jararaca") |>
  varplot(genotype = "n_het", fill = "land_type", facet = "land_type", title = het_title)

all_smp |>
  filter(species == "jararaca") |>
  varplot(genotype = "n_diff", fill = "land_type", facet = "land_type", title = diff_title)
```

### *jararaca* by state

```{r}
all_smp |>
  filter(species == "jararaca") |>
  varplot(genotype = "n_alt", fill = "state", facet = "state", title = alt_title)

all_smp |>
  filter(species == "jararaca") |>
  varplot(genotype = "n_het", fill = "state", facet = "state", title = het_title)

all_smp |>
  filter(species == "jararaca") |>
  varplot(genotype = "n_diff", fill = "state", facet = "state", title = diff_title)
```

### By sex

Sex is worth checking as a confounder of the comparisons above: females are
hemizygous over the differentiated part of the Z, which lowers their
heterozygosity even after the sex-linked loci have been removed.

```{r}
all_smp |>
  filter(!is.na(sex)) |>
  varplot(genotype = "n_het", x = "sex", fill = "sex", facet = "species",
          title = het_title, xlab = "Sex")

all_smp |>
  filter(!is.na(sex)) |>
  varplot(genotype = "n_diff", x = "sex", fill = "sex", facet = "species",
          title = diff_title, xlab = "Sex")
```
